rules.description: Every factual claim must reference at least one source.
AI generated images must not be used as the sole evidence for factual results, charts, equations, or tables.
Sections should use concise poster copy and avoid long report-style paragraphs.
Factual visuals should reference their source data, paper, project note, or code evidence.
Titles, section headings, labels, and annotations must remain readable at physical poster scale.
NatWest palette tokens should only apply when the NatWest theme or palette is explicitly selected.
A complete run should produce a poster spec, preview render, trace log, and export artifacts.
